description: Show what the user (or their AI assistants) has recently done in ExpenseBot via this MCP server: which tools were called, when, with what arguments, and whether they succeeded. This is a log of assistant TOOL CALLS, not the processing history of a document. Useful for questions like 'what did I do this week' or 'which tools has my assistant run', and to give the user transparency into AI-assisted actions. Returns the most recent N entries from the audit log (default 20, max 100).

actionId.description: Optional: filter to a single tool/action name

sinceDays.description: Only show actions from the last N days (default 7)

name: get_recent_activity
